messages.author: 24c32d464f0c38bf
messages.subject: start time of SIB
parts:
Hi Vincent, 

Thank you for your consistent effort on helping people. As a beginner, I have two questions when using GGIR:

1. GGIR estimates the bouts of sustained inactivity. I have set it as time period with no change in arm angle larger than 5 degrees over at least 5 minutes (T5A5). From the report, the sleep/night-related data of sib I can obtain is number_sib_sleepperiod. How can I know the the exact start time and end time of each SIB window? I also do not find configuration parameters to report this. 
2. Without sleep log, the sleepwindowType can not be set to TimeInBed, but I tried and it succeeded. I do not know why it can still works for some cases, but sometimes does not.

Thank you so much!

messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] start time of SIB
parts:
Re. 1. see parameter do.sibreport, which as of release 3.2-0 is TRUE by default.

Re. 2 the code checks whether parameter loglocation is non-empty. If yes, it concludes that sleep diary is present. By default loglocation is NULL. If you set it to a value, run GGIR, and then remove that line of code in GGIR, the value will still be in the config.csv file and retrieved by GGIR. So, to undo setting it to a value either explicitly set it to NULL or remove the config.csv file. This is also discussed here in the documentation.

Thanks,

Vincent

Dr. Vincent van Hees | Independent consultant | https://accelting.com/

messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] start time of SIB
parts:
They are stored in subfolder "...\meta\ms5.outraw\sib.reports".
Note that the exported time series may actually be more interesting to work with for you as they also come with information about how they overlap with the other information GGIR generates and/or summarises.

Best,
Vincent

I am actually searching for the first bout of sib after start time of the SPT. What did I miss?...

You're the best,
Ivy
